scares.description: Frank is looking around in the bathroom when Sara comes up to him and he gets scared.
The thunderstorm might startle some viewers.
When Frank leaves the kitchen, a big and loud lightning strikes outside.
There’s a dramatic zoom-in on the window, where you see a mysterious figure, accompanied with loud music.
When the mailman turns around, Allan is standing behind him.
When Allan turns up the volume on the device, there’s a sudden loud noise.
Frank is awoken by a strange banging sound.
Sara screams as she sees Allan at the foot of her bed.
Frank puts his ear against the door and hears a loud bang on the other side.
Frank falls in through the attic window.
There’s a sudden cut to a close-up of the ghostly figure, accompanied with an eerie sound.
